name: Counseling and Human Development (Dick's House)
description: Free, confidential short-term counseling, groups and workshops for Dartmouth students (stress, anxiety, mood, relationships). Same-day urgent appointments available.
contact: Dick's House, 7 Rope Ferry Rd; (603) 646-9442; after hours call the same number for the on-call counselor

name: Dick's House Health Service
description: Student primary care clinic (illness, injuries, sleep problems, nutrition) with nurse advice line.

name: Alumni Gym
description: Main campus gym with fitness center, indoor track, pool and drop-in group classes; open to students.
contact: Alumni Gym, 6 Rope Ferry Rd; recreation.dartmouth.edu

name: Academic Skills Center (tutoring)
description: Free peer tutoring, study-group support and coaching on time management, test preparation and procrastination.

name: Baker-Berry Library study rooms
description: Quiet floors and bookable group study rooms; good for focused work blocks and group projects.
contact: Baker-Berry Library; reserve rooms via library.dartmouth.edu

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
description: Free, confidential 24/7 support for people in suicidal crisis or emotional distress (US).
contact: Call or text 988; chat at 988lifeline.org. In immediate danger call 911.

name: Crisis Text Line
description: Free 24/7 text-based support with a trained crisis counselor.

name: Collis Student Center
description: Student center with cafe, lounges, student-organization events and activities; easy low-pressure place to connect with people.
